title: a merge that changes a lab source recompiles the congruency lab
intention: A git merge into cairn or CairnCommons that changes a lab source (a beside-code intention+why charter or an intentions-not-beside-code entry) pokes recompile_gate.sh, so intentions-congruency-lab matches its sources the moment the merge lands.
why: Measured 2026-11-16 (akienasus_cc_0): 9555's merge 28744a27c changed bin/intention+why.json; the lab copy stayed at 33937 bytes against a source of 34344, so test_compiler's test_verify_on_the_real_repo went red and cost 6fb272ba3d64 a walk; q148 recompiled the lab by hand. The house repos carry pre-commit and commit-msg hooks and no post-merge, so no merge has ever poked the gate.
traces_to: Law 1 (the model consult reads a current model instead of re-deriving it). Law 9 (a lab drifted by a merge reads red with nothing wrong in the code).
how: A tracked post-merge hook beside the compiler reads the names ORIG_HEAD..HEAD changed and pokes recompile_gate.sh when any is a lab source; recompile_gate.sh gains an 'install <repo>' mode that lays the hook. Red-first proof merges in scratch repos.

clauses.claim: in a scratch cairn/CairnCommons pair with the hook installed, merging a branch that changes a beside-code intention+why charter leaves the lab copy (CAIRN_LAB_OUT) byte-equal to the merged source
merging a branch that changes no lab source leaves every lab file's bytes and mtime untouched

recompile_gate.sh install <repo> lays an executable post-merge into $(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/hooks, a second install leaves it byte-identical, and recompile_gate.sh with no args still compiles as before

decisions.text: D1: cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/hooks/post-merge (bash) runs 'git diff --name-only ORIG_HEAD HEAD'; when any name ends in 'intention+why.json' or starts with 'intentions-not-beside-code/' it execs the recompile_gate.sh path baked in at install; it always exits 0 and is silent on success (the gate already records failure to its log, Law 7).

D2: recompile_gate.sh 'install <repo>' writes the hook into the repo's common hooks dir with the gate's absolute path substituted, chmod +x, idempotent; any other first argument (or none) keeps today's compile path unchanged.
D3: the proof builds temp git repos only (never the house trees), points CAIRN_COMMONS_ROOT, CAIRN_CODE_ROOT, CAIRN_LAB_OUT and CAIRN_LOG_DIR at them, one tooth per clause, PROVES keys '1','2','3'.

out: laying the hook on every fleet box (the installer's)
